description: This file contains the implementation of the ExceptionGrain class, which is a Orleans grain that provides various methods to throw and handle exceptions for testing purposes.

classes.name: ExceptionGrain
classes.description: A Orleans grain class that implements methods to throw different types of exceptions, useful for testing error handling.

methods.name: Canceled
methods.description: Returns a Task that has been canceled.

methods.name: ThrowsInvalidOperationException
methods.description: Asynchronously throws an InvalidOperationException after a delay.

methods.name: ThrowsAggregateExceptionWrappingInvalidOperationException
methods.description: Throws an AggregateException that wraps an InvalidOperationException.

methods.name: ThrowsNestedAggregateExceptionsWrappingInvalidOperationException
methods.description: Throws nested aggregate exceptions wrapping an InvalidOperationException.

methods.name: GrainCallToThrowsInvalidOperationException
methods.description: Calls another grain to throw an InvalidOperationException.

methods.name: GrainCallToThrowsAggregateExceptionWrappingInvalidOperationException
methods.description: Calls another grain to throw an AggregateException wrapping an InvalidOperationException.

methods.name: ThrowsSynchronousExceptionObjectTask
methods.description: Synchronously throws an InvalidOperationException and returns it as a Task<object>.

methods.name: ThrowsMultipleExceptionsAggregatedInFaultedTask
methods.description: Returns a Task with multiple exceptions set.

methods.name: ThrowsSynchronousAggregateExceptionWithMultipleInnerExceptions
methods.description: Synchronously throws an AggregateException with multiple inner exceptions.
